title: ZIRNOX
description: The &3ZIRNOX&r is the first and cheapest nuclear reactor that one can make. Unlike the &3PWR&r and &3RBMK&r, it is a fully assembled reactor which requires &bWater&r and &bCarbon Dioxide&r to operate.
A ZIRNOX running on &6Natural Uranium Fuel Rods&r, at 14000mb of carbon dioxide and on 3 &3Industrial Turbines&r can produce up to &e285.6kHE/s&r.
